description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: WISMO & Order Inquiries

eval_cases.input: What is our overall self-service deflection rate for WISMO order inquiries over the last 30 days?

What is the total dollar amount of customer appeasement credits issued due to shipment delays this month?
Break down WISMO inquiry volume by customer channel and status at inquiry.
Are there widespread regional carrier delays or supply chain disruptions impacting FedEx and UPS delivery times currently?
